description: This file contains integration tests for the 'Create Catalog Item' API endpoint in an ASP.NET Core application. It tests authorization and successful creation of catalog items, utilizing MSTest framework with methods to send HTTP requests, handle JSON serialization, and assert responses.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the 'Create Catalog Item' API endpoint, verifying authorization handling and correct response payload.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Verifies that a normal user token results in a 403 Forbidden response when attempting to create a catalog item.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Verifies that an admin token results in a successful creation and returns the expected data for a new catalog item.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Creates and serializes a JSON payload representing a new catalog item request.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Test method to ensure normal users are forbidden from creating catalog items.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Test method to ensure admin users can successfully create catalog items and receive correct response data.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Helper method to generate JSON content for the create catalog item request.
